resetPassword.hint: At least 12 characters, and at most 72 bytes when UTF-8 encoded (Thai counts as 3 bytes per character).

resetPassword.success: Password has been reset, and this user's existing sessions were revoked.

errors.mismatch: The two passwords do not match
errors.tooShort: Password must be at least 12 characters
errors.tooLong: Password is too long — at most 72 bytes when UTF-8 encoded (Thai counts as 3 bytes per character)
errors.failed: Could not set the new password

signup.title: Self-signup

approval.title: New user approval
